action_visual: on the sixth day it rains outside; Gu Shen leaves his wet umbrella at the door, dark water stains on his suit shoulders, and chooses a window seat instead of the counter
source_text: 顾深第六天来，外面在下雨。他选了靠窗的位子。美式

action_visual: Su Nian brings the cup; Gu Shen holds it without drinking, gazing at the rain, saying her coffee is better than downstairs and it is quiet here
spoken_dialogue: 你的咖啡比楼下的好。而且……安静。
source_text: 你的咖啡比楼下的好。而且安静

action_visual: Gu Shen calls her back to ask why she won't consider cooperation; Su Nian answers that this shop was left to her by her grandmother, who has passed away
spoken_dialogue: 因为这是外婆留给我的。她去世了。
source_text: 上次你说不考虑合作。因为这是外婆留给我的。去世了

action_visual: Gu Shen falls silent and drinks, leaving his lip print on the rim; behind the counter Su Nian's hands tremble, remembering their fingers touched when she served him
focus_object: his lip print on the cup rim
source_text: 顾深沉默了。杯沿留着他的唇印。苏念的手在发抖，她的手指碰到了顾深的手指

action_visual: Su Nian realizes the earlier memory of the rain-girl vision is fading — she remembers seeing it but not the details — and knows she needs to read him again
source_text: 那段记忆正在变淡。她需要再读一次

action_visual: Gu Shen finishes and leaves; Su Nian walks over, picks up the still-warm cup and closes her eyes
focus_object: coffee grounds swirling in the cup
source_text: 顾深起身要走。苏念端起杯子。杯壁还有温度。她闭眼

action_visual: the world falls silent; a clearer vision comes — Gu Shen in his office before a contract, the address 'Old Town Alley No.17' — Nianxiang's address — circled in red pen, then he rubs his temples
inner_voice: 为什么要亲自来？让小李去谈就行了。但那家店……那个咖啡师……她看我的眼神不像其他人。其他人看我的职位、我的公司、我的表。她看的是——
focus_object: red pen circle on the contract
source_text: 画面：顾深在办公室，合同地址老城区巷子17号。她看我的眼神不像其他人

action_visual: Su Nian sets the cup down, hands trembling, realizing he is not only here to acquire; she looks at her hands — the burn scar remains but the utility-knife scar on her right index finger has faded like a washed photograph
focus_object: faded scar on right index finger
source_text: 他不只是来收购的。右手食指那个美工刀划的痕迹淡了

action_visual: Su Nian notices Gu Shen left his umbrella by the door, grabs it and chases out into the alley
focus_object: his umbrella left by the door
source_text: 他的伞还靠在门边。苏念拿起那把伞，追出去

action_visual: the alley is empty, rain hitting the flagstones; Su Nian stands in the rain holding his umbrella, raindrops running down onto her wrist, blurring the fading scar further
focus_object: raindrops on her fading wrist scar
location: rain-soaked alley outside the coffee shop
source_text: 巷子里空无一人。她站在雨里，手里握着他的伞。雨水打在她的手腕上
